attributes.action: Make appropriate climate control a requirement for public facilities.
attributes.additional_details:
Buildings and transport in the UK are inappropriately equipped to deal with changing weather across the seasons.

The government should work with UK bus companies to arrange a removal of diesel buses from the country and replace them with the newer electric buses across all networks. 

Additionally, implementation of appropriate air conditioning units (and potentially heaters) as required in public facilities should be supported by the government.
attributes.background: There should be a legal limit to the minimum and maximum temperatures that public facilities such as bathrooms and buses are able to reach. Appropriate climate control should be legislation to prevent strain on individual safety, healthcare companies and economic growth.

rejection.details:
You may be interested in this petition, which calls for similar action: "Mandate working a/c and heating systems on all new public transport vehicles" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771285

Petitions also need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action. We weren't quite sure what you meant by "public facilities" but you may be interested in the following petitions.

Require local authorities to have a cooling strategy
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770934

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/774023

Introduce national heatwave resilience strategy & legal protections
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770813

Create a legally enforceable maximum working temperature
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770354
